settings.label: Use these fonts in every section
settings.info: Turn off to let a section keep a font of its own. Text sizes stay adjustable in each section either way.

settings.label: Google font name

settings.label: Google Fonts embed code

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.info: Space between lines of body text across the theme.

settings.label: Google font name

settings.label: Google Fonts embed code
settings.info: Paste the link code Google Fonts gives you for that family.

settings.label: Size
settings.info: Scales standard theme headings. Sections with their own heading size keep that size.

settings.label: Line spacing
settings.info: Space between lines of headings across the theme.

settings.label: Menu link hover
settings.info: How a top menu link reacts when the pointer is on it. The header can follow this, or pick its own.

settings.label: Button shape, size and hover effect are under Buttons. Button colours are in Color schemes.
settings.content: Button shape, size and hover effect are under Buttons. Button colours are in Color schemes.

settings.label: Content width
settings.info: How wide text and grids get on large screens.

settings.label: Wide content width
settings.info: Used by sections whose width is set to Fluid container.

settings.label: Side padding
settings.info: Space between the content and the edge of the screen.

settings.label: On phones
settings.info: A section's own top and bottom padding is added to this.

settings.label: Round the corners of pictures and boxes
Form field radius
settings.info: Text, email, number, select and message fields.

settings.label: Search field radius
settings.info: 100 makes a full pill.

settings.label: Tag and chip radius
settings.info: 100 makes a full pill.

settings.label: Right-to-left languages
settings.info: Language codes, separated by commas, that switch the store to right-to-left.

settings.label: Set a shared shape, text style and spacing here. Button colors are in Colors → the color scheme used by each section. Navigation arrows, quantity controls and language selectors keep their own layout.
settings.content: Set a shared shape, text style and spacing here. Button colors are in Colors → the color scheme used by each section. Navigation arrows, quantity controls and language selectors keep their own layout.

settings.label: Use shared button size and shape
settings.info: On: apply these text, padding, border and corner settings to theme action buttons and Storelib buttons. Off: allow local section sizing. Links and button actions are unchanged.

settings.label: Primary button appearance
settings.info: Styles primary calls to action. Secondary and outline buttons retain their role. Colors come from the section’s color scheme.

settings.label: Rounded corner radius
settings.info: Used when shape is set to Rounded.

settings.label: Round icon button size
settings.info: Dedicated round icon buttons only. Carousel arrows, quantity controls and language selectors keep their functional sizes.

settings.label: Enable Custom
settings.info: When OFF, the product-card action buttons (Add to Cart, Wishlist heart, Remove X) inherit the Button Primary scheme automatically. Turn ON to override the colours below.

settings.label: Hover effect
settings.info: Affects cards such as: banner, collection, blog…

settings.label: Rounded corner
settings.info: Only used when shape is Rectangle or Square chip.

settings.label: Edge offset (sides)
settings.info: Distance from the card edge.

settings.label: Label text
settings.info: Used when Sale badge format is set to Text.

settings.label: Enable color swatches on product cards & quickview
Swatch display style
settings.info: Color swatches: small color dots. Variant images: tiny variant thumbnails.

settings.label: Maximum swatches shown
settings.info: Extra colors are summarised with a + count.

settings.label: Color option name(s)
settings.info: Comma-separated list of variant option names that should render as color swatches. e.g. Color, Colour, Cor

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: Colors for the slide-out drawer only.

settings.label: Allow editing variants in drawer
settings.info: Shows Edit beside cart items that have product options such as size or color.

settings.label: Edit button label
settings.info: Tooltip and accessible label for the variant-edit icon.

settings.label: Cart control appearance size
settings.info: Adjusts the quantity outline and remove icon. Touch areas stay at least 44px for easy use.

settings.label: Cart drawer footer actions
settings.info: Choose which buttons show under the subtotal. Two buttons share one row; a single button fills it.

settings.label: Checkbox label
settings.info: Use the word LINK (all caps) to mark where the policy link should appear in the sentence.

settings.label: Policy link
settings.info: Link the label to any policy page (Terms of service, Privacy, Refund, Shipping, etc.). Leave blank to use the shop's Terms of service URL automatically.

settings.label: Show order note
settings.info: Add an order-note tool in the drawer.

settings.label: Show discount code
settings.info: Add a discount-code tool in the drawer.

settings.label: Show shipping estimate
settings.info: Adds a shipping estimate button beside the order note and discount code.

settings.label: Show estimate shipping rates
settings.info: Enables the calculator. To show it in the drawer, also enable Shipping estimator under Cart Drawer.

settings.label: Require terms agreement before checkout
settings.info: When enabled, Checkout stays disabled until the shopper checks the box.

settings.label: Free-shipping order amount
settings.info: Order amount for free shipping, for example 150. The bar stays hidden while this is empty.

settings.label: Use a custom fill color for the free-shipping progress bar
settings.info: When OFF the bar follows the active color scheme.

settings.label: Product recommendations
settings.info: Controls the drawer. Shopping Cart has its own recommendation settings.

settings.label: Also show recommendations on cart page
settings.info: Adds the cart page while Inside drawer is selected. Disable hides recommendations everywhere.

settings.label: Recommendations source
settings.info: Automatic and selected products use the same product card layout.

settings.label: Products to recommend manually
settings.info: Used when source is Selected products.

settings.label: Customize recommendation button colors
settings.info: When OFF, the Add-to-Cart button on cart recommendations uses the theme's Button Primary scheme. Turn ON to override with the colours below.

settings.label: Text color
settings.info: Leave blank to use the cart drawer's text color. Choose a color here only to override the drawer scheme.

settings.label: Use custom SVG icons
settings.info: When enabled, paste your own <svg> for each badge below. Stroke uses currentColor.

settings.label: Badge 1 — SVG (used when SVG icons toggle is ON)
Message
settings.info: Use {time} as a placeholder for the countdown.

settings.label: Daily cutoff time (24h, store timezone)
settings.info: Format: HH:MM. After this hour the message hides until the next day.

settings.label: Message
settings.default: 🎁 Spend $75 more and unlock a free gift

settings.label: CTA label (optional)
settings.info: Leave blank to use the message itself as a clickable link.

settings.label: Show when stock is at or below
Message
settings.info: Use {qty} for the remaining stock and {name} for the product title.

settings.label: Message
settings.info: Use {amount} for the saved amount.

settings.label: Rate
settings.info: Points: rate per $1. Cashback: percent (e.g. 5 = 5%). Fixed: dollar amount.

settings.label: Message
settings.info: Use {value} for the calculated reward.

settings.label: Shipping amount ($)
settings.info: Use whole numbers, no currency symbol.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold ($)
settings.info: Used in 'Free over threshold' mode. Cart subtotals at or above this amount show as free.

settings.label: Delivery window
settings.info: Shown after the price (e.g., '2–5 business days'). Leave blank to hide.

settings.label: Free shipping label
settings.info: Used when shipping is free (threshold met or amount = 0).

settings.label: Badge height (Mobile)
settings.info: Applied only on mobile (≤749px). Desktop uses the slider above.

settings.label: Controls the full cart page only. Arrange its content blocks in the Shopping Cart section.
settings.content: Controls the full cart page only. Arrange its content blocks in the Shopping Cart section.

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: Colors for the full cart page only.

settings.label: Show order note
settings.info: Let customers leave a note on the cart page.

settings.label: Show discount code
settings.info: Show discount-code entry on the cart page.

settings.label: Cart page choose gift wrap product
Cart page show estimate shipping rates
settings.info: Show the shipping calculator on the full cart page.

settings.label: Use a custom fill color for the free-shipping progress bar
settings.info: When OFF the bar follows the active color scheme.

settings.label: Recommendations source
settings.info: Automatic and selected products use the same product card layout.

settings.label: Products to recommend manually
settings.info: Used when source is Selected products.

settings.label: Customize recommendation button colors
settings.info: When OFF, the Add-to-Cart button on cart recommendations uses the theme's Button Primary scheme. Turn ON to override with the colours below.

settings.label: Checkbox label
settings.info: Use the word LINK (all caps) to mark where the policy link should appear in the sentence.

settings.label: Policy link
settings.info: Link the label to any policy page (Terms of service, Privacy, Refund, Shipping, etc.). Leave blank to use the shop's Terms of service URL automatically.

settings.label: Setup — required for the wishlist page to work
Wishlist items are saved in the visitor's browser. In Storelib, check that your site includes a wishlist page using the wishlist template.
settings.content: Wishlist items are saved in the visitor's browser. In Storelib, check that your site includes a wishlist page using the wishlist template.

settings.label: Preview the header heart link and confirm it opens your wishlist page. Test saving and removing a product before publishing.
settings.content: Preview the header heart link and confirm it opens your wishlist page. Test saving and removing a product before publishing.

settings.label: Saved items belong to each browser and are not shared between devices.
settings.content: Saved items belong to each browser and are not shared between devices.

settings.label: Popup vertical spacing
settings.info: Controls the top and bottom padding of the search popup. Drawer search is unchanged.

settings.label: Search layout animation
settings.info: Controls how the search modal appears and disappears (Popup and Basic types).

settings.label: Color scheme
settings.info: Pick a color scheme to apply to the search drawer / popup — controls its background, text, borders and buttons. Leave blank to inherit the page's default scheme.

settings.label: Popular searches
settings.info: Comma-separated list shown below the search field.

settings.label: Filled in once here and shown wherever a section asks for it, such as the footer's Store info block.
settings.content: Filled in once here and shown wherever a section asks for it, such as the footer's Store info block.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: Include the country code, for example +40 712 345 678.

settings.label: Store or contact page
settings.info: Where links to your store details lead.

settings.label: Paste full URLs (https://…) for any platforms you want shown in the footer / floating social bar. Leave blank to hide an icon.
settings.content: Paste full URLs (https://…) for any platforms you want shown in the footer / floating social bar. Leave blank to hide an icon.

settings.label: Threads
settings.info: Full Threads profile URL

settings.label: X (Twitter rebrand)
settings.info: Full X profile URL — alternate to legacy Twitter field

settings.label: Telegram
settings.info: Full Telegram channel / group link

settings.label: Discord
settings.info: Full Discord invite link

settings.label: Spotify
settings.info: Full Spotify artist / playlist URL

settings.label: Reddit
settings.info: Full subreddit / profile URL

settings.label: Use custom social media styles
settings.info: When OFF, social icons inherit the theme defaults (outline style, 18px size, 12px gap, heading color). Turn ON to override with the custom style + colors + sizes below.

settings.label: Icon style
settings.info: Only applies when "Use custom social media styles" is enabled.

settings.label: Icon color
settings.info: Only applies when "Use custom social media styles" is enabled. Leave blank to inherit from the active color scheme.

settings.label: Icon background (chip / circle styles)
settings.info: Only applies when "Use custom social media styles" is enabled, and only for Rounded chip / Circle styles.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.info: Only applies when "Use custom social media styles" is enabled.

settings.label: Gap between icons
settings.info: Only applies when "Use custom social media styles" is enabled.

settings.label: Show share buttons on product pages
settings.info: Adds Facebook, X, Pinterest, Email and Copy-Link share buttons to the product page.

settings.label: Floating social bar (sticky on side of page)
Reveals content below the first screen once as it scrolls into view. Content already visible and editor updates stay visible. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
settings.content: Reveals content below the first screen once as it scrolls into view. Content already visible and editor updates stay visible. Reduced-motion preferences are respected.

settings.label: Animation when sections enter the viewport
settings.info: Triggered as the user scrolls down the page. Affects opacity and transform only — never colors. Applies to all content sections (header, footer, popups and utility sections are excluded automatically).

settings.label: Animation delay before start
settings.info: Time to wait before each item begins animating after entering the viewport.

settings.label: Applies to image cards across the theme — banner, collection, blog, lookbook. The product card has its own hover effect setting under Theme settings → Product card.
settings.content: Applies to image cards across the theme — banner, collection, blog, lookbook. The product card has its own hover effect setting under Theme settings → Product card.

settings.label: Enable zoom on hover for product / image cards
Optional loading overlay for storefront navigation. Longer durations delay access to the page. It is disabled in the editor; check it in a storefront preview.
settings.content: Optional loading overlay for storefront navigation. Longer durations delay access to the page. It is disabled in the editor; check it in a storefront preview.

settings.label: Enable Preloader
settings.info: Shows a loading overlay on page navigation. Leave off for immediate page transitions. Always disabled in the Storelib editor.

settings.label: Custom Preloader Image Logo or GIF
settings.info: Upload your own preloader image or GIF. You can create or download GIF animations from external sources like Gifer. Simply download the GIF and upload it here.

settings.label: Customize the size and duration of the preloader below.
settings.content: Customize the size and duration of the preloader below.

settings.label: A full-screen animated intro the shopper sees BEFORE the storefront loads. Customise the background, logo, loading bar, and on-screen text — all under your brand.
settings.content: A full-screen animated intro the shopper sees BEFORE the storefront loads. Customise the background, logo, loading bar, and on-screen text — all under your brand.

settings.label: Enable Website Intro
settings.info: Enable this option to activate the website intro animation.

settings.label: Show the intro only on the first load of the website
settings.info: If enabled, the intro will be shown only once when a user visits the site for the first time.

settings.label: Behavior

options.label: Show only on first access of the site

settings.info: How the intro appears. 'First access' shows it once for new visitors. 'Every page' shows it on every page load. 'Always (Testing Mode)' shows it every time — use only while customising. 'Once per day' uses local storage to remember the last show. (If you want to preview the feature outside Testing Mode, try a private/incognito window.)

settings.label: Intro Duration (seconds)
settings.info: How long the intro animation should be visible.

settings.label: Enable Background Color instead of Image
settings.info: If enabled, the intro background will use a solid color instead of an image.

settings.label: Background Color
settings.info: Choose the background color for the intro when 'Enable Background Color' is active.

settings.label: Background Image
settings.info: Upload an image to use as the intro background. Overrides background color if selected.

settings.label: Background Image Brightness (0-100)
settings.info: Adjusts the brightness of the background image (0 = darkest, 100 = normal).

settings.label: Background Image Blur (px)
settings.info: Applies a blur effect to the background image. Higher values create a stronger blur.

settings.label: Use my theme's main logo when no custom intro logo is set
settings.info: When ON (default), the intro shows the same logo you uploaded in Theme Settings → Logo. To override, upload a custom 'Intro Logo Image' below — that always wins. Turn this OFF to hide the logo entirely when no custom intro logo is set.

settings.label: Intro Logo Image (optional override)
settings.info: Upload a custom logo for the intro. Overrides the theme's main logo when set. Leave empty to use the theme logo (if the toggle above is ON).

settings.label: Logo Image Size (px)
settings.info: Set the size of the logo image in pixels.

settings.label: Logo Animation
settings.info: Select an animation effect for the intro logo.

settings.label: Enable Text Above Loading Bar
settings.info: If enabled, a custom text message will be displayed above the loading bar.

settings.label: Intro Loading Text
settings.info: Enter the text to display above the loading bar.

settings.label: Loading Bar Style
settings.info: Choose a style for the loading bar animation.

settings.label: Enable White Glow for Loading Bar
settings.info: If enabled, the loading bar will have a white glow effect.

settings.label: Start with the recommended performance options. Try experimental options one at a time and check your storefront after each change.
settings.content: Start with the recommended performance options. Try experimental options one at a time and check your storefront after each change.

settings.label: Faster images & fonts (recommended)
settings.info: Serves right-sized images, lazy-loads images below the fold, preloads the hero image, decodes images off the main thread, and shows text instantly while fonts load. Biggest speed win — no visual change.

settings.label: Battery & motion friendly (recommended)
settings.info: Pauses off-screen carousels and videos to save battery, and respects a visitor's “reduce motion” device setting. Your animations stay fully on for everyone else.

settings.label: Snappier page navigation
settings.info: When a visitor hovers a link, the next page quietly starts loading in the background so the click feels instant.

settings.label: Defer third-party apps & scripts
settings.info: Delays chat, reviews and analytics widgets until the page has loaded — a big performance-score boost. Leave off first; turn it on, then check those widgets still work.

settings.label: Priority homepage image (optional)
settings.info: For the largest above-the-fold hero image. Only set one when needed; this improves loading priority without loading images for unseen sections.

settings.label: Cycles the browser tab title to grab attention when a visitor switches to a different tab. Resets the moment they return.
settings.content: Cycles the browser tab title to grab attention when a visitor switches to a different tab. Resets the moment they return.

settings.label: Enable tab title rotation when away
Switch interval
settings.info: How long each message stays in the tab title before rotating to the next.

settings.label: Swap favicon when visitor switches tabs
settings.info: Shows an alternate favicon (e.g., a red dot) so the tab is easy to spot in their browser bar.

settings.label: Away favicon
settings.info: Square image, ideally 32×32 or 64×64 PNG / SVG.

settings.label: Show cart count in tab title
settings.info: Prepends the cart item count to the page title (e.g., '(2) Product Name | Store').

settings.label: Cart tab title template
settings.info: Use {count} for the item count and {title} for the original page title.

settings.label: Show inactivity nudge after idle period
settings.info: Triggers an additional message in the tab title if the visitor has been inactive for the time below.

settings.label: Banner style
settings.info: Buttons follow your theme's global button settings (shape, radius, colors, font).

settings.label: Content cookies
settings.default: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized ads or content, and analyze our traffics. By clicking "Allow Cookies" you consent to our use of cookie. More info

settings.label: Enable simple styling
settings.info: Override the banner's colors and button radius with your own. Leave off to follow your theme styles.

settings.label: Corner radius
settings.info: -1 keeps the theme's own
